owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

__gap.details: The storage slots reserved for future usage.

firstCrossDomainMessageIndex.details: If `index < firstCrossDomainMessageIndex`, the message is in `L1MessageQueueV1`.

messageRollingHashes.details: The list of queued cross-domain messages. The encoding for `bytes32` is ```text [      32 bits      |   224 bits   ] [ enqueue timestamp | rolling hash ] [LSB                            MSB] ``` We choose `32` bits for the timestamp because it is enough for next 81 years. The remaining `224` bits is secure enough for the rolling hash.

nextCrossDomainMessageIndex.details: Also the total number of appended messages, including messages in `L1MessageQueueV1`.
